notes.title: July 7th Update Notes
notes.content:
[p]• Optimized Mission Descriptions
• Fixed plot purchasing requiring the incorrect quantity (now correctly requires 4 as stated in the text, previously erroneously set to 6).
• Fixed cleaner chasing vehicles.
• Fixed camera clipping through terrain.
• Fixed UI misalignment on the settlement screen.
• Fixed mission title text overflow issues.
• Reduce purchase prices for all recipes.[/p]
